hand_vs_gate.note: hand-carded truth (true/false) against the gate's verdict; 'unverified' gate rows are counted as disagreement with a hand true/false

second_model.note: non-Claude reviewer on adopts that target a project; disagreement sends the idea to trial

outcomes.note: tested applications only; notes written but untested are not counted

links.note: sources opened by the research agents, fetched again now

audit.note: blind: the auditor never saw our label. Agreement counts 'reliable' for verified, 'partly/unverifiable/reliable' for trial, 'funnel/false' for suspicious.

gold.note: gate truth against gold labels; the gold set was also used to tune rules G2b/G3c/funnel, so the blind audit (fresh sample) is the held-out test. Gold set for the reel pipeline.
